summary: Frontend-only re-verification of the two iteration_1 fixes plus two regressions on NekSathi. (1) Mobile drawer at 390x844: portaled drawer renders as full-height right panel (box x=60,w=330,h=844, position:fixed, bg rgb(11,11,22), z=3001), overlay covers full viewport (390x844) and clicking it closes/unmounts the drawer; all links (m-sol-personal, m-schools, m-login, m-register) visible and contained inside the panel. (2) Logged-in dropdowns at 1920: logged in via OTP mock (+919812345678, dev_code shown on screen) -> /dashboard; nav-assets-menu and nav-more-menu both computed background rgb(13,12,22) with opacity 1, z-index 90; document.elementFromPoint at top/middle/bottom of each panel returns only panel-internal elements (no 'Add vehicle' or page content bleeding through) - visually confirmed opaque in screenshots. Navigation works: nav-a-tags -> /tags, nav-m-incidents -> /incidents. (3) Public desktop Solutions mega-menu opens with all 7 items visible and opaque bg rgb(13,12,22). (4) Logged-in nav remains a SINGLE row at 1920 (7 visible header controls, element tops 16/20/22px inside one 64px bar). No console errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: .solutions-mega keeps backdrop-filter: blur(16px) from .glass while now having an opaque background - the blur is dead cost; can be dropped for perf.
Public site has no <header> element (nav is a div) - purely semantic/a11y nit, consider using <header>/<nav> landmarks.
seed_data_creation: OTP mock user created for phone +919812345678 (name 'Test') via /otp-login mock flow.
test_credentials: Admin admin@safeqr.com/admin1234 (unused this run); OTP mock login +919812345678 with on-screen dev code.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both iteration_1 issues (mobile drawer collapse, translucent logged-in dropdowns) are confirmed fixed. OTP request is rate-limited 5/min per IP - avoid repeated login loops in one run; dev code appears in [data-testid=otp-dev-code] text as 'your code:NNNNNN'. Correct testids on OTP page are otp-phone/otp-request-btn/otp-code/otp-verify-btn (not otp-send-btn). Remaining untested this iteration: deeper feature flows (vehicles, tags CRUD, SOS, family, admin console) and backend APIs.
rca_of_the_issue: Prior mobile drawer collapse was caused by an ancestor creating a containing block/overflow context for the position:fixed drawer; the React portal to document.body resolves it (verified drawer height == viewport height). Dropdown translucency was due to .glass semi-transparent background; .solutions-mega now sets solid #0d0c16, verified via computed style and elementFromPoint hit-testing.
